number: Score-optimal value K = 0 (595 ops). Could a nonzero K delete fold sites instead? Exact scans of one K word (m_{2j}, y = 0) over 2^32 values: column 0 zeroes v4' for 1 value, v8' for 1, v12' for 2 (v0' for 2), columns 1..3 zero at most one single site each (col 1: none, col 2: v10', col 3: v11' for 3 values); no value zeroes two outputs of a column. So one nonzero word saves at most 1 op and costs 2 (net +1), two words save at most 2 per column and cost 4. Zero degrees of freedom worth keeping: K = 0 is optimal for cost.
